title: The Gem
evidenceText: Fourth studio album, debut release on 4AD, out Sept 25. Lead single 'Get Away From Me (I Think I'll Love You Soon)' is out, fuzzy eighties-leaning jangle rock about wanting love and wanting freedom at once. Recorded in a converted hotel room above a Melbourne bar with the same three musicians, with actual noise curfews because the building is residential. One outlet described the record as feeling excavated rather than manufactured.

title: Melodie
evidenceText: Third studio album, out Sept 18 via ANTI-. Follows 2023's Yard. Lead single 'Better Man' is out, described as anthemic and propulsive. Produced by Elliott Kozel, the first time the band worked with an outside producer instead of self-producing.

title: Mount Zero
evidenceText: Debut album from an Adelaide, Australia four-piece, out July 17 via Winspear (their first international signing). No prior album history, just a 2024 self-released EP called Oxalis. Press describes it as alt-rock and 90s slowcore influenced, self-recorded and self-produced by the band.

title: Oxis 9
evidenceText: Ninth in a rapid-fire numbered album series from an LA electropop artist, out July via Boom Records. Two singles out so far, described as glitchy synth pop with heavy autotune, compared in press coverage to Charli XCX.

title: (hypothetical mainstream pop album)
evidenceText: Hypothetical test case: a fully produced, radio-ready pop album, no indication of the Aaron Dessner / folklore-style register.

title: (hypothetical folklore-style album)
evidenceText: Hypothetical test case: press describes a hushed, diaristic album, co-produced with Aaron Dessner of The National, in the register of folklore/evermore rather than her usual pop albums.
